lines.zh: 我一抽一抽地在水里游。
lines.en: I swim in little jerks through the water.
I drift a short way with the water.
I rise toward the lit surface.

lines.zh: 我围绕着一小簇藻游动。
lines.en: I swim around a small clump of algae.
I shift a little to the side.
My leg bristles keep rowing.
I hover just above the sandy bottom.
I make for that patch of weed.
I make one small slow loop.
I follow the ripples deeper.
I work through the crowd of my kind.
I swim up another stretch.
I move in small fits and starts.
I drift forward close to the bottom.

lines.zh: 我从石头的缝隙里钻过去。
lines.en: I slip through a crack in the stones.
I float slowly back to mid water.
I head for the saltier water.

lines.zh: 我转了个方向，往浅处去。
lines.en: I turn toward the shallows.
I hang there with my bristles still working.

lines.zh: 我对着水里的一点发呆。
lines.en: I stare at a speck in the water.
I hold still and drift with the water.
I tip my body downward.
I cling to a tiny speck.
A shadow passes over the surface.
I spread my bristles and filter the water.
I roll over slowly.

lines.zh: 我在水草边停了一会儿。
lines.en: I pause by the weed a while.
This body of mine is half transparent.
I float up a little more.
I float without the least motion.
I rest on a strand of weed.
I curl my body into a loop.
I turn toward you.
Your shadow darkens the water.
I am on the bottom, you on dry land.
I swim a little closer and back off.
I circle the shadow you cast.

lines.zh: 我停下来，对着你的方向。
lines.en: I stop, facing your way.
You do not reach in, so I stay.
I hide behind the weed.
The surface makes me look bigger.

lines.zh: 我又朝你那边浮了一点。
lines.en: I float a little more toward you.
The water knocks me over and over.
I roll myself tight.
I cannot swim and drift with the water.
A rent has opened in me.
I come round by small degrees.
I sink toward the deep.
It is hard for me to move.
I hide in a crack between stones.
I keep that in the salt water.

lines.zh: 我半透明的身子散了半边。
lines.en: Half of my see-through body has come apart.
Something has scattered in the water.
I swim toward those crumbs.
I filter them one grain at a time.
That will feed me a while.
I hold one and nibble slowly.
I rise for more.
I spread all my bristles.
The smell of the water changed.
I circle that clump of crumbs.
I eat until my belly swells.

lines.zh: 我被水流推得翻了半圈。
lines.en: The current rolls me half over.
I twitch and shift away.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞对我来说太大。
lines.en: That bump is huge to me.
I drift to the other side.
I am pressed against the weed.
I steady myself slowly.
The water is murky and I cannot see well.
I curl up and wait for you to go.
I float back to where I was.
A body this small cannot take a knock.
I swim into the middle of them.
I carry the eggs and drift slowly.
I circle a mate once.
We knot up in a tiny cluster.
The water presses us together.
I release a few eggs.
I move and they scatter.
My eggs are among this swarm.
I swim back into the depths.
That is nothing; only instinct.
I cling to the crumb.
I filter it into my mouth.
This grain will not be bitten.
I cradle the crumb in my legs and strain it.
It slips out between my legs.
I hold it under my body.
I have got it down.
Not fresh; I let go.
I swim off holding one grain.
I look for the next one.
A shadow moves in the water.
I turn that way.
I draw my bristles in.
Someone has come near.
I sink deeper.
I stop at the weed's edge.
I feel the water shake.
I tuck myself out of sight.
It is far bigger than I.
I float without moving.
I watch its side.
When it moves, the water rocks.
I retreat into the weed.
I lie pressed to the bottom.
I edge away by degrees.
It is still in that shadow.
I count the times it moves.
I dare not rise.
The weed hides me.
I press against the salty bottom, afraid to stir.
I meet it head on.
I push it away with my bristles.
That force is far too small.
I beat my legs and paddle backward.
I butt one more time.
It pushes me back.
I cling to it.
I let go and sink.
I flee into the weed.
I have quit.
I hatched in the water.
My kind are all around me.
The water here is just salty enough.

lines.zh: 我第一下就划动了腿毛。
lines.en: My first stroke sets my bristles moving.
I float toward the light.
There are grains of salt on the bottom.
I circle the salt pile.

lines.zh: 我躲开水流最急的地方。
lines.en: I avoid the fastest current.
I settle onto the weed.

lines.zh: 我一出现，就有一群跟来。
lines.en: The moment I appear, a swarm follows.

lines.zh: 水被烧热，我拼命往深处钻。
lines.en: The water heats and I dive for the deep.

lines.zh: 我从水里落到石上，翻了个身。
lines.en: I fall from the water onto stone and roll over.

lines.zh: 水里的气不够了，我乱划。
lines.en: There is not enough air and I thrash.
The blast fills the water with bubbles.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过我，我散了一角。
lines.en: Something passes through and a corner of me scatters.
Cold force wraps me in the water.

lines.zh: 水里没有吃的，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No food in the water and I grow lighter.
Lightning runs through the water and through me.

lines.zh: 没有水也没有底，我一直往下。
lines.en: No water and no bottom, and I fall on.
